_README: Manifest for the weekly skill/plugin update checker. The CHECK is deterministic (git/pip only, ZERO LLM tokens). It only REPORTS what is new — REVIEW-BEFORE-APPLY: it NEVER auto-updates anything. You read skill-update-report.md and update each item yourself, one at a time.
_baseline_rule: last_seen_commit is the baseline used to detect 'something changed upstream'. The normal weekly check NEVER edits the baseline (so you cannot miss an update). Only `check.ps1 -Ack` records the current upstream HEAD as the new baseline — run it ONLY after you have actually applied the update.
_ls_remote_caveat: Personal skills are checked with `git ls-remote <repo> HEAD`, which returns the WHOLE repo's HEAD, not the HEAD of subpath_in_repo. So a change anywhere in the source repo will flag the skill as 'maybe updated' even if your subpath did not change. This over-reports on purpose — it is safe because you review before applying.

git_plugins._note: Git-backed plugin caches are discovered AUTOMATICALLY by check.ps1 (it scans ~/.claude/plugins/cache for .git dirs). Listed here for documentation only; the script does not read this block.

npm_packages.note: Standalone agent-building toolkit (unified multi-provider LLM API + agent runtime + TUI + coding CLI). Installed 2026-08-09 via npm. RE-TESTED 2026-08-09: original v0.74.2 install had lost its `pi` shim (likely from an earlier interrupted npm operation) -- `pi: command not found`. Reinstalled cleanly with `npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.74.2` (pinned; @latest is 0.84.1 and requires Node >=22.19.0, this machine has v22.12.0 -- EBADENGINE warning). CONFIRMED WORKING: `pi --version` -> 0.74.2, `pi --help` renders full usage, `pi -p "..." @missingfile` correctly reports file-not-found, and `pi -p "..."` against a real prompt correctly detects no provider API key configured and prints /login guidance. Fully functional CLI, just needs a provider key or `pi /login` (OAuth) to do real work. Update with: npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@latest (watch the Node engine requirement before jumping past 0.74.x).

pip_packages.note: Standalone CLI that audits/grades an AI agent or LLM endpoint against a provider+judge+test-suite. Installed 2026-08-09 via `pip install "ifixai[anthropic]"` (v3.3.0). RE-TESTED 2026-08-09: `ifixai run --provider mock --strategic` (smoke test with the built-in mock target, no target API key needed) still requires a real provider key for the grading judge -- fails cleanly with "no provider credentials found in the environment. Set at least one of OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ...". No such key is exported in this environment (only ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is set, not ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) -- did not fabricate one. `ifixai setup` is interactive (prompts), not runnable non-interactively either. CLI itself, --help, and error handling all work correctly -- purely blocked on a missing key. Once the user exports one: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... ifixai run --provider anthropic --strategic` (or `ifixai setup` interactively). Update with: pip install -U ifixai[anthropic]

The /graphify skill wrapper is user-authored; its ENGINE ships as pip dist 'graphifyy'. Update with: pip install -U graphifyy. Provenance confirmed 2026-08-08 via pip show graphifyy Home-page field = safishamsi/graphify; Graphify-Labs/graphify (seen on trendshift.io) is a different, unrelated repo — no fork/rename relationship found.
Skill wraps Microsoft MarkItDown (pip dist 'markitdown'). Update with: pip install -U markitdown
